<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>surrealich · dejaquetepique</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;1,300;1,400&family=DM+Mono:wght@300;400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --void:#07081F;--deep:#0D0E3A;--indigo:#1A1B5E;
  --teal:#1B8A8A;--teal-light:#4EC4C4;--teal-dim:rgba(78,196,196,.15);
  --ember:#E8722A;--cream:#E8E4F0;--ghost:rgba(232,228,240,.55);
  --serif:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;
  --mono:'DM Mono',monospace;
}
html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden}
body{background:var(--void);color:var(--cream);font-family:var(--mono);cursor:crosshair}

/* ── GRAIN ── */
body::after{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.03'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  pointer-events:none;z-index:999;opacity:0.5}

/* ── CANVAS BG ── */
#bgCanvas{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0}

/* ── MAIN HUB ── */
#hub{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s ease}

/* ── ALTAR / BEE ── */
#altar{position:relative;width:min(280px,42vw);height:min(280px,42vw);cursor:pointer;z-index:20;flex-shrink:0}
#altar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(59,184,195,.35)) drop-shadow(0 0 80px rgba(59,184,195,.15));
  animation:float 8s ease-in-out infinite,pulseGlow 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#altar-label{position:absolute;bottom:-2.5rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.48rem;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(78,196,196,.4);white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none}

/* ── NODES ── */
.node{position:absolute;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;
  transition:transform .3s ease,opacity .3s ease;z-index:15}
.node:hover{transform:scale(1.12) !important}
.node:hover .node-circle{border-color:var(--teal-light);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(78,196,196,.4),0 0 60px rgba(78,196,196,.15)}
.node:hover .node-label{opacity:1;color:var(--teal-light)}

.node-circle{width:min(90px,14vw);height:min(90px,14vw);border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.3);background:rgba(13,14,58,.8);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:all .4s ease;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.node-icon{font-size:min(1.6rem,3.5vw);line-height:1}
.node-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:min(.5rem,1.5vw);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(232,228,240,.45);transition:all .3s;text-align:center;max-width:90px;line-height:1.4}

/* Connector lines (SVG overlay) */
#connectors{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:8;pointer-events:none}

/* ── PAGES ── */
.page{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;
  background:var(--void);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .5s ease,transform .5s ease;transform:translateY(30px)}
.page.active{opacity:1;pointer-events:all;transform:translateY(0)}

/* Back button */
.back-btn{position:fixed;top:1.5rem;left:1.5rem;z-index:200;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(78,196,196,.5);cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.2);
  padding:.5rem 1rem;background:rgba(7,8,31,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  transition:all .3s;display:none}
.back-btn:hover{color:var(--teal-light);border-color:var(--teal-light)}

/* Page inner */
.page-inner{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:5rem 2rem 4rem}
.page-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5vw,4.5rem);font-weight:300;
  font-style:italic;color:var(--cream);margin-bottom:.5rem;line-height:1}
.page-sub{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--teal-light);opacity:.6;margin-bottom:3rem}
.divider{width:40px;height:1px;background:var(--teal-dim);margin:.8rem 0 3rem}

/* Work grid */
.work-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;background:rgba(78,196,196,.06)}
@media(max-width:700px){.work-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.work-item{background:var(--void);padding:2.5rem 2rem;cursor:pointer;
  transition:background .4s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.work-item::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--teal),var(--ember));
  transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .5s}
.work-item:hover{background:var(--deep)}
.work-item:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.work-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.48rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--teal-light);
  opacity:.35;margin-bottom:1rem}
.work-cat{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.5rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ember);opacity:.7;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.work-name{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:300;color:var(--cream);
  line-height:1.15;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.work-name em{font-style:italic;color:var(--teal-light)}
.work-desc{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--cream);opacity:.45;max-width:380px}
.work-meta{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.48rem;color:rgba(78,196,196,.3);margin-top:1.2rem;letter-spacing:.1em}
.work-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:1rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;
  letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-light);text-decoration:none;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.25);padding-bottom:3px;transition:all .3s}
.work-link:hover{color:var(--cream);border-color:var(--cream)}

/* Video placeholder */
.video-slot{margin-top:1.2rem;border:1px dashed rgba(78,196,196,.15);padding:.8rem 1rem;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.48rem;letter-spacing:.12em;color:rgba(78,196,196,.2);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem}
.video-slot::before{content:'▶';color:rgba(78,196,196,.25);font-size:.6rem}

/* Practice */
.practice-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3rem}
@media(max-width:700px){.practice-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.practice-block{margin-bottom:2rem}
.pblock-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.5rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--teal-light);opacity:.6;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.pblock-body{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;line-height:1.9;color:var(--cream);opacity:.55}
.pblock-body strong{color:var(--cream);opacity:1;font-weight:700}
.skills-wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;margin-top:.8rem}
.skill-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.48rem;letter-spacing:.08em;
  color:rgba(78,196,196,.5);border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.15);padding:3px 8px}
.bio-quote{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.2rem;font-style:italic;
  color:rgba(78,196,196,.5);border-left:2px solid rgba(78,196,196,.2);
  padding-left:1.2rem;margin:2rem 0;line-height:1.7;max-width:580px}

/* Listen */
.listen-section{margin-bottom:2.5rem;padding-bottom:2.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.06)}
.listen-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:300;color:var(--cream);margin-bottom:.3rem}
.listen-sub{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.5rem;letter-spacing:.15em;color:rgba(78,196,196,.4);margin-bottom:.8rem}
.listen-body{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--cream);opacity:.45;max-width:520px;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.listen-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.8rem;margin-top:.6rem}
.listen-link{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--teal-light);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.25);
  padding-bottom:2px;transition:all .3s}
.listen-link:hover{color:var(--cream)}
.field-locations{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.48rem;letter-spacing:.1em;
  color:rgba(78,196,196,.25);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:.5rem}

/* Contact */
.contact-poem{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.5rem);font-style:italic;
  color:rgba(78,196,196,.4);margin-bottom:3rem;line-height:1.4;max-width:500px}
.contact-item{display:flex;gap:1.2rem;align-items:baseline;padding:.9rem 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.06)}
.contact-lbl{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.5rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--teal-light);width:70px;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.6}
.contact-val{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--cream);text-decoration:none;
  transition:color .3s;letter-spacing:.05em}
.contact-val:hover{color:var(--teal-light)}
.contact-sig{margin-top:3rem;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1rem;font-style:italic;
  color:rgba(78,196,196,.2)}

/* ANIMATIONS */
@keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-14px) rotate(1deg)}}
@keyframes pulseGlow{from{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(59,184,195,.25)) drop-shadow(0 0 60px rgba(59,184,195,.1))}
  to{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 60px rgba(59,184,195,.45)) drop-shadow(0 0 100px rgba(59,184,195,.2))}}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes lineGrow{from{stroke-dashoffset:300}to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}

#hub{animation:fadeUp 1.2s ease forwards}

/* Name tag top */
#nametag{position:fixed;top:1.8rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:100;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.5rem;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(78,196,196,.35);pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<canvas id="bgCanvas"></canvas>
<div id="nametag">Carlota Ruiz &nbsp;·&nbsp; surrealich &nbsp;·&nbsp; dejaquetepique</div>
<button class="back-btn" id="backBtn" onclick="goHome()">← back</button>

<!-- ═══════════════════ HUB ═══════════════════ -->
<div id="hub">
  <svg id="connectors" style="position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%"></svg>

  <!-- NODE: WORK (top) -->
  <div class="node" id="node-work" onclick="openPage('work')" style="position:absolute">
    <div class="node-circle"><div class="node-icon">✦</div></div>
    <div class="node-label">Work</div>
  </div>

  <!-- NODE: PRACTICE (left) -->
  <div class="node" id="node-practice" onclick="openPage('practice')" style="position:absolute">
    <div class="node-circle"><div class="node-icon">◎</div></div>
    <div class="node-label">Practice</div>
  </div>

  <!-- ALTAR (centre) -->
  <div id="altar" onclick="altarClick()">
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="dejaquetepique">
    <div class="altar-label">deja que te pique</div>
  </div>

  <!-- NODE: LISTEN (right) -->
  <div class="node" id="node-listen" onclick="openPage('listen')" style="position:absolute">
    <div class="node-circle"><div class="node-icon">◈</div></div>
    <div class="node-label">Listen</div>
  </div>

  <!-- NODE: CONTACT (bottom) -->
  <div class="node" id="node-contact" onclick="openPage('contact')" style="position:absolute">
    <div class="node-circle"><div class="node-icon">→</div></div>
    <div class="node-label">Contact</div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══════════════════ PAGE: WORK ═══════════════════ -->
<div class="page" id="page-work">
  <div class="page-inner">
    <div class="page-title">Work</div>
    <div class="page-sub">Sound · Event Direction · Installation · Live Performance · Coordination</div>
    <div class="divider"></div>
    <div class="work-grid">

      <div class="work-item">
        <div class="work-num">01</div>
        <div class="work-cat">Sound Score · Documentary</div>
        <div class="work-name">Sentinels of <em>Engaruka</em></div>
        <div class="work-desc">Full sound score for Ngoteya Wild's short documentary following Maasai communities and endangered giraffes in the Engaruka Valley. Every sound from the land — field recordings on location, Maasai singer Naomi's voice woven through every scene, a seismic mic on a djembe to find the giraffe's sound. Mix and mastering in 2.1 and 5.1 with Beneath the Baobabs Studios, Kilifi.</div>
        <div class="work-meta">Ngoteya Wild · Tanzania · 2025–2026 · releasing 21 June 2026</div>
        <a href="https://ngoteyawild.co.tz" target="_blank" class="work-link">ngoteyawild.co.tz →</a>
        <div class="video-slot">Video — coming June 2026</div>
      </div>

      <div class="work-item">
        <div class="work-num">02</div>
        <div class="work-cat">Event Direction · Sound Facilitation · Co-creation</div>
        <div class="work-name"><em>Sensuous</em></div>
        <div class="work-desc">Eleven immersive sensory events at QS1 Studios, Berlin. Co-created with Storm Hartley. Each event guided by the moon — somatic exercises, sound baths, altars, foraging, AV installations. Concept direction, graphic design, space holding, DJ sets. Born on my birthday. Still echoing.</div>
        <div class="work-meta">Berlin · QS1 Studios · 2022–2023 · with Storm Hartley</div>
        <div class="video-slot">Video documentation — pending</div>
      </div>

      <div class="work-item">
        <div class="work-num">03</div>
        <div class="work-cat">Audiovisual Installation</div>
        <div class="work-name"><em>SPIRAL</em></div>
        <div class="work-desc">Four-speaker audiovisual installation simulating cochlear implant perception. How does the world sound through an implant? My mother Alma's voice and experience. Julia Hann von Weyhern (cochlear implant user) as co-developer. Watercolours by my aunt Nuria Ruiz de Alegría from Madrid. Piano, drums and voice by Morgan Edgerton. The audience could listen with someone else's ears.</div>
        <div class="work-meta">Liebig12, Berlin · 2022 · surrealich & Critical P</div>
        <a href="https://liebig12.net/12-05spiralsurrealichcritical-pthefatesaremockingmemo-van-zandt-jso/" target="_blank" class="work-link">liebig12.net →</a>
      </div>

      <div class="work-item">
        <div class="work-num">04</div>
        <div class="work-cat">Live Performance · Psychoacoustics</div>
        <div class="work-name"><em>Circulus</em></div>
        <div class="work-desc">Four live performances in Berlin 2022–23. Loophole. Madame Claude. Ora collective. Autobahn — club commission. Feedback loops, no-input mixing, DIY hydrophones in jars of water on speakers. The shadow given a stage. Built on research into distortion product otoacoustic emissions. Influenced by Maryanne Amacher, Alvin Lucier, Knut Auffermann.</div>
        <div class="work-meta">Berlin · Loophole · Madame Claude · Autobahn · 2022–2023</div>
        <div class="video-slot">Performance footage — pending</div>
      </div>

      <div class="work-item">
        <div class="work-num">05</div>
        <div class="work-cat">Graphic Design · Visual Identity</div>
        <div class="work-name">Baobab Studios <em>002</em></div>
        <div class="work-desc">Visual identity and artwork for Baobab Studios' second release — Utsai si Nyuwi EP. Drawings, design, reflection on ancient knowledge and the seeds we carry. Grateful to be part of a space giving story a body to flow through.</div>
        <div class="work-meta">Baobab Studios · Kilifi · 2025</div>
      </div>

      <div class="work-item">
        <div class="work-num">06</div>
        <div class="work-cat">Sonic Performance · Biogeometry Institute</div>
        <div class="work-name">Museum of Consciousness — <em>Sensa</em></div>
        <div class="work-desc">Seven artists attempted to alter the audience's state of consciousness through sound alone. Before performing, private access to the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the Black Pyramid at Dashur, the Serapeum, the Osiris Shaft. Sensa built from Serengeti field recordings, layered vocals, binaural pulses and otoacoustic emission theory. The ear as instrument. The listener as unconscious performer.</div>
        <div class="work-meta">Cairo · April 3 2025 · Biogeometry Institute</div>
        <a href="https://surrealich.bandcamp.com/track/sensa" target="_blank" class="work-link">Listen on Bandcamp →</a>
      </div>

      <div class="work-item" style="grid-column:1/-1">
        <div class="work-num">07</div>
        <div class="work-cat">NGO Coordination · Leadership · Community Building</div>
        <div class="work-name">Born to Learn — <em>General Coordinator</em></div>
        <div class="work-desc">Two years as general coordinator of a Montessori community school in Moshi, Tanzania. Kindergarten, primary support, extracurriculars, a kitchen feeding everyone daily, maintenance, infrastructure, volunteering program, education team — all running simultaneously. Full budget management, donor reporting, volunteer coordination across international cycles, scholarship administration. I arrived not knowing the systems. I learned. Fast. Every question the project needed, I found an answer for.</div>
        <div class="work-meta">Born to Learn NGO · Moshi, Tanzania · Feb 2024 – Feb 2026</div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══════════════════ PAGE: PRACTICE ═══════════════════ -->
<div class="page" id="page-practice">
  <div class="page-inner">
    <div class="page-title">Practice</div>
    <div class="page-sub">Sound Artist · Field Recordist · Sonic Researcher · Event Director</div>
    <div class="divider"></div>
    <div class="bio-quote">Every project begins with a question that stings — and will not let go until it transforms something. The disciplines follow the question. Not the other way around.</div>
    <div class="practice-grid">
      <div>
        <div class="practice-block">
          <div class="pblock-label">Who</div>
          <div class="pblock-body">Carlota Ruiz. Also Charlie. Also surrealich. A bridge — between the land that holds a story and the antennas open enough to receive it. Between a community school in Tanzania and a feedback loop in a Berlin basement. Between the technical and the ceremonial.<br><br>
          <strong>BA Hons</strong> Electronic Music Production and Performance · Catalyst University Berlin · 2021–2023.<br>
          <strong>Base:</strong> Madrid & Kilifi, Kenya.<br>
          <strong>Languages:</strong> Spanish (native) · English (fluent) · Kiswahili (beginner)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="practice-block">
          <div class="pblock-label">How I work</div>
          <div class="pblock-body">I don't work from a discipline. I work from a question. The project tells me what it needs. I show up with everything I have — sound design, field recording, event direction, graphic design, project coordination, spatial audio, DIY instrument building, budget management, donor reporting. Whatever the question requires.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="practice-block">
          <div class="pblock-label">Sound Technician</div>
          <div class="pblock-body">RSO · OXI · Anomalie · Berlin · Apr–Nov 2022<br>
          PA build and teardown, console patching, audio routing, mic configuration, digital audio network setup. Stage and FOH, monitor levels, artist liaison.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="practice-block">
          <div class="pblock-label">Catalyst University Berlin</div>
          <div class="pblock-body">BA Hons Electronic Music Production and Performance · 2021–2023. Trident 88 console. Spatial audio, synthesis, composition, sound design, studio recording. Very low budget gear mastered to full potential.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="practice-block">
          <div class="pblock-label">Technical skills</div>
          <div class="skills-wrap">
            <span class="skill-tag">Ableton Live</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">VCV Rack</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Spatial audio</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Binaural mix</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">2.1 + 5.1 mix</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Signal flow design</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Field recording</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">DIY mic crafting</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Foley & ambience</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">No-input mixing</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Feedback systems</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Procreate</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Visual identity</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Budget management</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Donor reporting</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">M&E frameworks</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Volunteer coordination</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Event logistics</span>
            <span class="skill-tag">Stage management</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="practice-block" style="margin-top:1.5rem">
          <div class="pblock-label">Open to</div>
          <div class="pblock-body">Sound design commissions · documentary sound · field recording collaborations · event creation and concept direction · stage and festival management · graphic design · audiovisual installations · NGO storytelling · remote and international projects · and whatever question arrives that needs what I carry.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="practice-block" style="margin-top:1.5rem">
          <div class="pblock-label">Le Bous Sacré Residency</div>
          <div class="pblock-body">Kilifi · August 2025</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══════════════════ PAGE: LISTEN ═══════════════════ -->
<div class="page" id="page-listen">
  <div class="page-inner">
    <div class="page-title">Listen</div>
    <div class="page-sub">Field Recordings · Productions · DJ · Music Curation</div>
    <div class="divider"></div>

    <div class="listen-section">
      <div class="listen-title">Field Recording</div>
      <div class="listen-sub">My expansion of ears</div>
      <div class="listen-body">I go with intention. I ask before I record. I give the recorder to the people I'm with so they know this is a conversation, not an extraction. Forests, studios, streets, villages, wild spaces, ancient chambers. Every recording is a document of a moment that cannot be repeated.<br><br>
      Pending release: the Kisukuma ethnic group in Shinyanga — ritual ceremony, twins, the call and response of twenty men. Daily sound geographies from Tanzanian villages. Audio from inside the Great Pyramid, the Osiris Shaft, the Serapeum. These are finding their form.</div>
      <div class="field-locations">Kisukuma · Tanzania · Kenya · Switzerland · Egypt · Mallorca · Berlin · New York (hydrophones)</div>
      <div class="listen-links">

<script>
// ── BACKGROUND PARTICLES ──
const bgCanvas = document.getElementById('bgCanvas');
const bgCtx = bgCanvas.getContext('2d');
function resizeBg(){bgCanvas.width=window.innerWidth;bgCanvas.height=window.innerHeight}
resizeBg();window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{resizeBg();positionNodes()});
const particles=Array.from({length:60},()=>({x:Math.random(),y:Math.random(),r:.3+Math.random()*1.1,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.00015,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.00015,o:.04+Math.random()*.15,c:Math.random()>.6?'59,184,195':'232,114,42'}));
function drawBg(){const w=bgCanvas.width,h=bgCanvas.height;bgCtx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);particles.forEach(p=>{p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.x<0)p.x=1;if(p.x>1)p.x=0;if(p.y<0)p.y=1;if(p.y>1)p.y=0;bgCtx.beginPath();bgCtx.arc(p.x*w,p.y*h,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);bgCtx.fillStyle=`rgba(${p.c},${p.o})`;bgCtx.fill()});requestAnimationFrame(drawBg)}
drawBg();

// ── NODE POSITIONING ──
function positionNodes(){
  const altar = document.getElementById('altar');
  const hub = document.getElementById('hub');
  const ar = altar.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx = ar.left + ar.width/2;
  const cy = ar.top + ar.height/2;
  const r = Math.min(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight) * .36;
  const nodes = [
    {id:'node-work',    angle:-90},
    {id:'node-practice',angle:180},
    {id:'node-listen',  angle:0},
    {id:'node-contact', angle:90},
  ];
  nodes.forEach(({id,angle})=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    const rad = angle * Math.PI / 180;
    const nx = cx + Math.cos(rad)*r - el.offsetWidth/2;
    const ny = cy + Math.sin(rad)*r - el.offsetHeight/2;
    el.style.left = nx+'px';
    el.style.top  = ny+'px';
  });
  drawLines();
}

// ── CONNECTOR LINES ──
function drawLines(){
  const svg = document.getElementById('connectors');
  svg.innerHTML='';
  const altar = document.getElementById('altar');
  const ar = altar.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx = ar.left+ar.width/2, cy = ar.top+ar.height/2;
  ['node-work','node-practice','node-listen','node-contact'].forEach(id=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    const er = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const ex = er.left+er.width/2, ey = er.top+er.height/2;
    const line = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','line');
    line.setAttribute('x1',cx);line.setAttribute('y1',cy);
    line.setAttribute('x2',ex);line.setAttribute('y2',ey);
    line.setAttribute('stroke','rgba(78,196,196,.12)');
    line.setAttribute('stroke-width','1');
    line.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray','4 6');
    svg.appendChild(line);
  });
}

// ── NAVIGATION ──
let currentPage = null;
function openPage(name){
  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('hub').style.opacity='0';
  document.getElementById('hub').style.pointerEvents='none';
  document.getElementById('page-'+name).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('backBtn').style.display='block';
  currentPage=name;
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
function goHome(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('hub').style.opacity='1';
  document.getElementById('hub').style.pointerEvents='all';
  document.getElementById('backBtn').style.display='none';
  currentPage=null;
}
function altarClick(){
  // Subtle pulse on altar click
  const img = document.querySelector('#altar img');
  img.style.transform='scale(1.08)';
  setTimeout(()=>img.style.transform='',400);
}

// ── MOUSE PARALLAX ──
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
  if(currentPage) return;
  const mx=(e.clientX/window.innerWidth-.5)*12;
  const my=(e.clientY/window.innerHeight-.5)*8;
  document.getElementById('altar').style.transform=`translate(${mx}px,${my}px)`;
  ['node-work','node-practice','node-listen','node-contact'].forEach((id,i)=>{
    const d=.4+i*.1;
    document.getElementById(id).style.transform=`translate(${mx*d}px,${my*d}px)`;
  });
  drawLines();
});

// ── INIT ──
window.addEventListener('load',()=>{
  setTimeout(positionNodes,50);
});
window.addEventListener('resize',positionNodes);
</script>
</body>
</html>
